aws:requesttag/${tagkey}.description: Filters access by a tag's key and value in a request

aws:resourcetag/${tagkey}.description: Filters actions based on the presence of tag key-value pairs in the request

aws:tagkeys.description: Filters access by the tag keys in a request

route53:changeresourcerecordsetsactions.description: Filters access by the change actions, CREATE, UPSERT, or DELETE, in a ChangeResourceRecordSets request

route53:changeresourcerecordsetsnormaliz.description: Filters access by the normalized DNS record names in a ChangeResourceRecordSets request

route53:changeresourcerecordsetsrecordty.description: Filters access by the DNS record types in a ChangeResourceRecordSets request

route53:vpcs.description: Filters access by VPCs in request
